assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a realistic clothing catalog cutout for a digital wardrobe app.
Style: photorealistic professional studio product photography, premium real-world clothing, not illustration, not vector, not a 3D render.
Background: genuinely transparent PNG alpha, including the space around and between items; no white or colored background, no checkerboard baked into image.
Composition: square image, full product centered, approximately 10% clear transparent margin around the product silhouette, uncropped and entirely inside the canvas.
Lighting: soft neutral daylight from upper left, accurate color, gentle realistic self-shading on fabric and leather only, no cast shadow beyond product.
Avoid: person, model, skin, mannequin, hanger, clothes rack, branding, logos, lettering, text, watermark, labels with text, props, floor, scenery, external drop shadows.
Subject: one pair of khaki beige straight-leg chino trousers, front view photographed directly overhead as a carefully arranged flat lay. Full waistband, belt loops, button closure, front pockets, fly, both legs and hems visible; legs naturally separated slightly. Real beige cotton twill texture, subtle seams, authentic gentle fabric folds and volume. A wearable everyday garment, proportional tailoring, softly structured straight legs. Nothing inside or supporting the trousers visible.
